title: Comrades Marathon Race Information — entry fees, medals, records
claims: The 2027 entry fee is R1,200 for South African citizens, R2,000 for entrants from the rest of Africa and R4,500 for international entrants.
Badges and medals are awarded to all official finishers who complete the full distance within the 12-hour cut-off.
The Best Down Run times listed by the organiser are 5:13:58 by Tete Dijana in 2023 and 5:44:54 by Gerda Steyn in 2023.
2027 Start Group Seedings will be announced at the start of 2027.
All athletes must complete the medical questionnaire, available after login to the online entry profile.
The official substitution period will be announced at the start of 2027.
An entry is only confirmed once payment has been successfully processed, by card or online instant EFT.
Failure to meet the stipulated qualifying criteria results in the entry being rejected, removal from the entry database, and no race T-shirt or goodie bag.
